name: CHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Colorado Springs, CO · Norris Penrose Event Center
headline: Colorado state: Niwot sweeps the 5A titles
summary: Niwot swept the 5A titles. The No. 4 boys won their fourth straight with 60 points, well clear of Arapahoe (143), while Northfield's Abdinasir Hassan won the individual race in 14:56.41 and set the 5A course record. The No. 7 girls won with 47 points over No. 9 Boulder (100) and Fairview (116), and Cherokee Trail's Madison Lange won the individual title in 17:27.99. Coronado's Oliver Horton won the 4A boys race in 14:40.52 as Summit took the team title (75), and Eaton's Delaney Reuter won her third straight 3A girls title in 17:22.02 as Berthoud won the team title (62).
